summary: This manuscript proves four original, self-contained theorems resolving the resource-theoretic, dynamical, and mixed-state questions left open by Travaglino, Mazzoni, and Calabrese [1]. Specifically, it establishes exact sharpness of the U(1)-covariant monotonicity domains ({1} for Delta S^(alpha), [0,2] for Petz D_alpha, [1/2,infinity] for sandwiched S^(alpha)) in low dimensions (d = 2, 3, 4); constructs an explicit U(1)-covariant two-qubit Markov semigroup with exact time-independent CPTP intertwining that forbids crossings in every genuine U(1)-asymmetry monotone while Delta S^(alpha) (alpha != 1) exhibits a permanent spurious Mpemba crossing; proves all-k Parseval degeneracy at alpha = 1/2 and resolves the N_S = 2 ordered-SWAP phase transition analytically via Laguerre-Descartes' Rule of Signs (alongside a Bin(2,p) reversal at alpha = 1/5); and characterizes mixed-state index-inversion vs index-preservation regimes, single-qubit (d = 2) universal inequalities via four polynomial factorizations, simultaneous d = 3 breakdown, K-sector pinching ceilings, and an exact Z_K replica identity.
strengths: Sharp low-dimensional counterexamples (d = 2, 3, 4) proving that restricting QDPI to the asymmetry manifold (rho, rho_Q) and U(1)-covariant or strongly symmetric channels does not enlarge any Renyi monotonicity window.

Elegant Gram-matrix reduction and strict convexity proof of g(p) = <u|B_0^-p|u>/4^p - 1/2 resolving the alpha_c = 1/2 threshold for sandwiched S^(alpha) on a rank-2 qutrit family, backed by a five-integer-inequality certificate at alpha = 1/4.

Strong conceptual and operational result in Theorem 3.1: exact CPTP intertwining sigma_AB(t) = Phi_kill(rho_AB(t)) rules out Mpemba crossings in all U(1)-asymmetry monotones simultaneously while Delta S^(2) crosses permanently at a kappa-independent time t_*(2).

Clean analytic resolution of the N_S = 2 ordered-SWAP transition for all p in (0, 1/2) and alpha > 0 via Laguerre-Descartes' Rule of Signs on a 5-term Dirichlet polynomial, plus all-k Parseval degeneracy at alpha = 1/2.
Exact closed-form single-qubit polynomial deficits (27)-(30), simultaneous d = 3 breakdown, K-sector log K pinching ceilings, and exact finite-group Z_K replica formula (32).
weaknesses: Analytic proof of the strict sign flip across alpha_c = 1/2 in Theorem 4.2(b) is established only for N_S = 2; extending the Laguerre-Descartes argument to arbitrary even N_S >= 4 remains open.

Because lean/RenyiAsymmetryMpemba.lean uses zero external imports (no Mathlib real analysis or operator calculus), the 20 Lean theorems certify the finite algebraic identities, rational witnesses, and integer inequalities supporting Theorems 2.1-5.1, whereas the analytic limit arguments, Rolle/Laguerre-Descartes step, and Frechet expansions are verified solely by the paper proofs.
Only the aggregate MANIFEST SHA-256 digest is printed in the PDF; the 16 individual certificate digests C01-C16 are not printed inline.
